ns2:course.label: Lighting for Non-Theatrical Spaces and Styles
ns2:course.description: A strong focus on lighting for architecture, landscape architecture, special events, theme parks, museums, concerts and site-specific venues. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 231, THEA 423, THEA 431.
